jobs.description: As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors. Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers. Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements. Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. jobs.description: As AI agents become the primary interface for advertisers and partners on Amazon Ads, we are building agent-native identity and authorization infrastructure that treats AI agents as first-class participants. We believe every agent should have a unique identity, authenticate through purpose-built flows, receive only the permissions its declared purpose requires, and produce a complete audit trail of every action it takes. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define and drive the product strategy for Agent Identity and Authorization Infrastructure within Amazon Ads. You will own the roadmap for how 5,000+ partners and 2M+ advertisers grant, scope, and govern AI agent access to their advertising accounts — spanning agent registry, authentication, capability-scoped authorization, advertiser-facing controls, and auditability. This is a greenfield opportunity to define the trust layer for agentic commerce at Amazon scale. Key job responsibilities - Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for agent identity, authentication, and authorization — from 1P agent registry through 3P developer SDK and advertiser-facing access controls - Define product requirements for capability-scoped authorization models that go beyond tool-level access to intent-bound, time-bound, and data-bound delegation - Drive cross-functional alignment across 10+ engineering teams, API platform, security, and partner-facing organizations to deliver integrated agent trust infrastructure - Author PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical specifications for new authorization primitives (agent-to-agent delegation, programmable delegation tokens, spend controls, circuit breakers) - Define and track success metrics including agent adoption, authorization accuracy, advertiser control adoption, and developer onboarding time - Represent advertiser and partner needs in executive-level prioritization, translating complex authorization concepts into clear customer value propositions - Partner with engineering to make build/buy/integrate decisions on authentication protocols (M2M auth, short-lived tokens, OAuth extensions for agents) - Drive beta programs with external partners (agencies, integrators) to validate product-market fit before scaled rollout A day in the life You'll start your day reviewing agent adoption metrics and authorization error rates across 1P and 3P surfaces. You might spend the morning in a design review with engineers debating whether capability-scoped permissions should be enforced at the gateway or service layer. After lunch, you're leading a working session with a large agency partner (like PacVue or Teikametrics) to understand how they want to register and manage multiple specialized agents under their application. In the afternoon, you're writing the product spec for the advertiser-facing Agent Access UI — where advertisers see every authorized agent, scope what each can do, and revoke access instantly. You close the day aligning with your VP on the 3P agent sandbox launch timeline for unBoxed. Your internal stakeholders include engineering (Identity, Authorization, Data, and Access Experience teams), the Ads Agent Orchestrator team, Developer Experience (DX), and Partner Enablement. Your customers are advertisers who need control over AI agents accessing their accounts, partners building agentic integrations, and internal 1P agent teams shipping skills on the Ads Agent platform. About the team The Ads Agent Identity and Authorization Infrastructure (AI²) team owns identity and access management for Amazon Ads — for both humans and AI agents. We manage registration, account management, permission controls, and ad-product eligibility that serve as gateways to Amazon Ads, impacting 5K+ partners and 2M+ advertisers globally with 800K+ registrations per year and 5M+ active users. We are a team of builders who ship at high velocity — we launched agent registry and agent authorization for 1P agents in Q1 2026, and are now extending to 3P. We value customer obsession (advertisers must trust the agents acting on their behalf), ownership (you own the product end-to-end from vision through metrics), and bias for action (we ship iteratively with real partners, not in isolation). We are based in New York (JFK19).

jobs.description: Join us as a Software Development Engineer on the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, where you'll build intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and cinematic storytelling. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Nara, our AI-native content creation platform that empowers creators to produce professional animation and live action content featuring world-class intellectual properties at unprecedented speed and scale. In this role, you'll develop production-quality code for AI-powered creative tools while learning from experienced engineers and scientists. You'll work alongside creative professionals (animators, filmmakers, and storytellers) implementing features that directly transform how animation and live action/VFX content is made for Prime Video's most ambitious productions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who are passionate about AI/ML applications in entertainment and want to grow their skills while contributing to industry-defining products featuring iconic IPs. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain software components for our AI-native content creation platform, supporting professional animation and live action/VFX workflows Implement features across the stack—from backend services, media processing pipelines, and APIs to ML model integrations and creator-facing tooling—with guidance from senior engineers Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while participating in code reviews to both give and receive constructive feedback Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML scientists, applied scientists, product managers, and creative professionals to understand requirements and deliver solutions Contribute to integrations with industry-standard Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro Troubleshoot and debug issues in production systems, contributing to operational excellence and system reliability Participate in on-call rotations and contribute to improving system monitoring, alerting, and documentation Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to AI/ML systems, media processing, and distributed computing A day in the life As an SDE on the AI Studios team, you'll spend most of your time writing and reviewing code, with regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates on design discussions. A typical day might include building API endpoints for our creator tooling platform, implementing new features for our live action VFX pipeline, or debugging an integration with our proprietary AI models. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to work on-site alongside VFX artists and creative professionals, sitting with them as they use your tools, watching where workflows break down, and iterating rapidly to meet the demands of production timelines. You'll participate in team standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives while building your understanding of our systems. You'll have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers and gradually take on more complex challenges as you grow, all while working on technology that powers content featuring world-class IPs. About the team We're part of the Engineering org within newly established Prime Video's AI Studios Division, pioneering AI-native cinematic content creation. Our mission is to establish Amazon MGM Studios as the definitive leader in AI-enabled content creation—giving creators unprecedented control over AI outputs while materially reducing production costs and timelines for animation and live action productions featuring world-class intellectual properties. Our engineering team spans distributed systems engineers building scalable infrastructure, ML engineers optimizing model training and inference, and full-stack engineers crafting intuitive interfaces for creative collaboration. We're building Nara, our AI-native platform, along with proprietary AI models (Genies) for animation, Live Action/VFX copilots, and integrations with industry-standard creative tools. We work in a fast-paced, innovative environment where you'll contribute to technology transforming how iconic entertainment content is made. Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

Lead and Scale Regional Operations:
Oversee day-to-day fulfillment and logistics operations across your designated area, ensuring strict adherence to safety standards, delivery timelines, and Coupang’s customer-centric quality benchmarks.
Drive Continuous Process Improvement:
Identify operational bottlenecks and implement methodologies to optimize workflow efficiency, reduce cycle times, and minimize variable costs across the network. Analyze complex supply chain data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to forecast operational capacity, mitigate risks, and present actionable insights to executive leadership.
Manage Complex Cross-Functional Projects:
Champion high-impact logistics initiatives by aligning and influencing diverse stakeholders, including frontline team leaders, procurement, technology, and corporate strategy partners.

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (equivalent practical experience also welcomed).
8+ years of experience
in logistics operations, supply chain management, warehousing, or fulfillment network management.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills—the ability to translate complex operational data into compelling narratives for executive stakeholders.

Experience working and collaborating with diverse, high-performing teams in a rapidly growing or hyper-growth environment.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to dive deep into fulfillment data, extract insights, and deploy scalable solutions.
Experience managing complex logistics projects while leading and influencing various stakeholders, from frontline associates to corporate leadership.
Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence, workplace safety, and exceptional leadership.
Proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop both junior supervisors and senior operations leaders.
